enable_flow.summary: Permission validator is registered on the EXISTING Kernel account via ONE enable-mode UserOp. Kernel v3 picks the validator from the userOp.nonce key field (validation type + validator id packed in high nonce bits — exact packing in zerodevapp/kernel v3.1 src/ValidationManager.sol). enableData is authorized by a ROOT-validator signature (current PRIVATE_KEY). After enable, every op uses the permission nonce-key signed by the ops key alone.
enable_flow.signature_format: enable op: signature = root-signed approval of (signer+policies+action) ‖ session-key sig over userOpHash; later ops: session-key sig only. Confirm packing vs ValidationManager.sol + SDK serializeEnableSignature.
enable_flow.commander_action: one-time root signature on the enable approval (scripted; offline box preferred)

layer2_turnkey.custody: ops key = Turnkey secp256k1 private key in a sub-org. Host holds only a Turnkey API credential. Signing = POST /public/v1/submit/sign_raw_payload (ACTIVITY_TYPE_SIGN_RAW_PAYLOAD_V2) on the 32-byte userOpHash — wire-identical to today's owner.sign_message output.
layer2_turnkey.honest_limitation: raw-payload signing exposes NO eth.tx.* context — Turnkey cannot see the calldata inside a userOpHash. Semantic confinement is enforced ON-CHAIN by Layer 1 (CallPolicy reverts disallowed calls). Turnkey adds: actor scoping, consensus, instant revocation, non-exportable key, immutable audit.

policies.condition: activity.type in [<CREATE_POLICY|EXPORT_PRIVATE_KEY|DELETE_PRIVATE_KEYS|UPDATE_USER activity enums — finalize against live enum at setup>]

tx_signing_variant_for_conveyor.note: if a Turnkey key ever signs real txs (GAP-28 conveyor), eth.tx.* becomes available:
tx_signing_variant_for_conveyor.abi_route: upload Roles/executor ABI → eth.tx.function_name == 'sweepNative' style conditions, or raw eth.tx.data[0..10] == '0x78c093cf' (docs.turnkey.com/features/policies/smart-contract-interfaces + /examples/ethereum)

defense_in_depth.host_RCE_reads_ENV: no PRIVATE_KEY in ENV; Turnkey API cred alone is scoped to raw-payload signing on one key id
defense_in_depth.turnkey_api_key_leak: attacker can only REQUEST sigs → org policy + on-chain CallPolicy still bind output to executor calls; anomaly audit + instant API-user revoke
defense_in_depth.ops_key_fully_extracted: key can ONLY yield UserOps the permission validator accepts: execute/sweep/sweepNative on deployed executors, sweep-to == Safe, flashProvider whitelisted, sponsored-gas-only, ≤60 ops/hr; cannot move account funds, change validators, or redirect sweeps
defense_in_depth.root_key_compromise: root stays god-mode → rotate root validator to cold/Turnkey custody post-enable (Commander action)

preconditions: Kernel account derivable per chain (aa.rs account_address already does this)
CHAIN_PROFIT_SAFE deployed (GAP-20 dep — 'to' pinning needs the address)
rollback: owner-signed op to setValidation/installValidation reverting to pure-ECDSA root (document Kernel v3.1 uninstall path before executing)
kill ops key: Turnkey delete key or policy — session ops stop validating instantly; on-chain permission remains registered but inert
time-boxed alternative: configure validUntil on the permission — on-chain expiry, no action needed

aa.rs: permission-mode ops (permission nonce key; session sig only)
signer trait: PrivateKeySigner | TurnkeyRawPayloadSigner (reqwest, API-key auth, zero key material on host)
probe binary: print executeCall::SELECTOR literal + eth_call assert on each executor
commander_actions: Turnkey org/sub-org, ops key, automation API user, 3 policies
deploy CHAIN_PROFIT_SAFEs (GAP-20) BEFORE freezing CallPolicy args
rotate root validator to cold after enable confirmed on every chain
